purpose: Resolve right-edge observation semantics without changing the signal, costs, assets, timeframe, stop, target, hold, source block or readiness thresholds.

rules.readiness_resolved_cohort: only signals whose entry timestamp plus the frozen 160x6H maximum-hold window is fully observable before 2026-09-01T00:00:00Z
rules.right_censored_signals: reported separately as RIGHT_CENSORED_NOT_ELIGIBLE_FOR_READINESS_OUTCOME; they are not counted as wins, losses, resolved trades, or unresolved execution-path errors
rules.unresolved_execution_path_gate: applies only to eligible signals with a fully observable max-hold window and measures price-path ambiguity/data failure, not ordinary right censoring
rules.concentration_basis: positive BASE net-R contributions only, identical semantics to Phase 5 clarification
rules.source_gap_gate: sum of source-gate detected minute gaps and incomplete canonical 15m bars must be zero
